title: Answer
description:
Today is said to worshippers, and it is said long after the wilderness, so a later hearer stands under the same oath.

The test was whether God was among them. It did not stay on one day, and it took the leader.

What was refused was a sworn gift, after signs. The oath barred that generation, not the children and not the two who believed. The unbelief was refusal, not ignorance.
